mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 42 degrees with clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail and an air quality index of 69. The Waxing Gibbous moon is visible in our skies.

City residents should know that Verona has launched a toilet rebate program for residential properties. Additionally, the Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving into a new phase with utility work completed and concrete work currently underway.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today features live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory. Tomorrow, look forward to art events at ART House 360 and trivia at Hop Haus.
Regarding the Verona Police Department weekly report, on Wednesday October 15, officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving behavior.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Covered Strawberry. If you are planning a visit, please note that the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
